name: IDT Intranet Models
description: Generate 3D models and pictures on the IDT intranet GPU servers and deliver them into this game's assets. Reaches 10.108.15.66; nothing leaves the intranet.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Check the intranet model servers before generating, or when a generation fails for a reason that looks like the server rather than the request. Lists the loaded models and what each one does, asks the 3D launcher a deliberately empty request to prove the shared route really reaches a model (a route that is only registered fails inside the actor instead, and this tells the two apart), reads the segmentation service's health and whether it wants a platform token, and reads the GPU free-memory probe. Costs no GPU time and starts no generation. Note that these models are 'flexible' type: they generate, they can never drive a chat.

tools.name: model3d
tools.description: Turn one picture of this game into a 3D model on the intranet GPU servers and deliver the GLB into the game's assets. Hunyuan3D-2.1 (the default) gives a textured GLB with PBR maps in about a minute; TRELLIS.2-4B (model=trellis2-4b) gives a GLB with PBR materials in about two minutes and takes image input only. Each call occupies a shared GPU, so generate once and reuse the result rather than calling repeatedly. Returns the delivered path, the job id, and the server's own timing. Load the GLB from the returned path and look at it in the preview.

name.description: The asset's name: letters, digits, dashes or underscores, at most 40. snake_case and capitals become lowercase with dashes.

image.description: One picture of this game, relative to the game folder, for example assets/concept.png. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 24 MiB. Not an absolute path. This is what image_to_3d uses, and the normal case.

prompt.description: Optional: a text description, for text_to_3d on hunyuan3d-2.1 only. With a prompt and no picture this becomes text to 3D; with both, the picture wins unless task says otherwise.

views.description: Optional: four pictures of the same object, front, back, left and right, as one comma-separated list of game-relative paths, for multiview_to_3d on hunyuan3d-2.1 only.

model.description: Which 3D model to run: hunyuan3d-2.1 (default, textured GLB, also does text and multiview) or trellis2-4b (image only). Leave it out for the default.

task.description: Optional: image_to_3d, text_to_3d or multiview_to_3d. Normally left out, since the arguments already say which one: a prompt means text, views means multiview, a picture means image.

tools.name: image
tools.description: Generate or edit a 2D picture on the intranet GPU servers and deliver it into the game's assets. With a prompt alone it is text to image (FLUX.2-klein-4B, about ten seconds per call) and delivers one picture; with a picture of this game as well it is instruction-based editing (Qwen-Image-Edit: add, remove, change, retouch lettering, restyle, change viewpoint) and delivers the four views the editing service returns — front, left, top and perspective. The plugin picks the model from whether a picture came with the prompt, so there is no model to choose. Good for textures, decals, concept art and UI art. Returns the delivered paths and the job id; look at the pictures before using them.

name.description: The asset's name: letters, digits, dashes or underscores, at most 40.

prompt.description: What to make, or how to change the reference picture, in words. Chinese and English both work.

image.description: Optional: a picture of this game to edit or use as reference, relative to the game folder, for example assets/sketch.png. Giving one turns this into instruction-based editing.

tools.name: segment
tools.description: Cut the objects out of a picture of this game on the intranet segmentation service (GroundingDINO + SAM2), one picture per object, and deliver them into the game's assets. Run this first when one picture shows several objects that should become separate models, then call model3d once per cut-out picture. The service takes one inference at a time and needs a platform user token in this plugin's 'segment-token' setting; without one it answers MODEL_LOGIN_EXPIRED. Returns the delivered files and the job id.

name.description: The asset's name prefix: letters, digits, dashes or underscores, at most 40.

image.description: The picture to segment, relative to the game folder, for example assets/scene.png. PNG, JPEG or WebP, at most 24 MiB.

prompt.description: Optional: what to look for, for example 'the chairs'. Left out, the service finds every distinct object.

tools.name: raw-infer
tools.description: Escape hatch for the shared Xinference route: POST a JSON body you supply to /v1/flexible/infers and read the raw answer back. The route needs {"model": "<uid>", "args": [ {the model's payload} ]} — without the args list it fails inside the actor with 'argument after * must be an iterable, not NoneType'. Use this only to try a payload shape this plugin does not already send, and ask the person first: it can occupy a shared GPU.

body.description: The whole JSON request body, as text, for example {"model":"hunyuan3d-2.1","args":[{}]}.

tools.confirmation: This sends a hand-written request to the IDT intranet GPU server and can occupy a shared GPU. Send it?

skills.name: idt-intranet-models
skills.summary: When to generate a 3D model or a picture on the IDT intranet GPU servers instead of making it by hand, which model does what, how the assets land in the game, and what a refusal means.
